expandContractCompatibility.boundary: Adds new content item and immutable revision tables; existing Phase 4 write paths are unchanged.
Adds review storage and revision identity uniqueness; existing content writes remain valid.
Adds route, publication, history, and discovery tables without removing the previous content contract.
Broadens publication kinds and relaxes route identity for non-Project content; Project publications still require a route identity.
Adds testimonial publication and projection tables without changing existing write requirements.
Adds immutable route history and broadens Owner discovery scope for lifecycle management.
Adds an append-only lifecycle history table; existing content rows and writes remain valid.
Adds nullable status references and default-false Featured columns; existing Project inserts retain valid defaults.
Adds relationship, view, and history tables without changing existing content writes.
Adds Taxonomy and assignment tables plus nullable discovery projection fields; existing Project writes remain valid.
The new history check requires Owner actor IDs for rename, retire, and merge writes. Deploy the actor-aware #120 writer with this migration and do not keep older actor-less writers online.
Adds two indexes only; no application contract changes.
